title: Relay reported success while native session remained active
symptom: Provider-layer succeeded signal preceded reliable native task completion.
root_cause: Relay run completion does not imply the underlying Harness native session has reached terminal state.
resolution: Correlate precise run with native session and stable artifacts; Codex independently reviews diff and tests; retain an idempotency key and never re-dispatch on an early succeeded event.
prevention: Two-stage terminal gate, stable artifacts, deduplicated events and fail-closed when native status is unavailable.

verification.method: Codex independently reviewed changes, reported 26 state tests and 12 bridge tests and recorded the conclusion in Issue #3
